pchickey commented on PR #14916:

I can't think of any reason a user might want to import wasi:io as a named import, or that an embedding would provide it as one. wasi:io is a singleton and so there being another instance of the same interface is nonsensical.

In general I see the wasip2 interfaces and implementations as being "done" and only getting bug fixes, and we are focusing all our energy for new development on wasip3. So, in general, I would require significant convincing that any of the p2 interfaces should be made compatible with named imports, even if unlike wasi:io they aren't a special case that should always be singular.

In general I see the wasip2 interfaces and implementations as being "done" and only getting bug fixes, and we are focusing all our energy for new development on wasip3. So, in general, I would require significant description of a real use case motivating that any of wasmtime's implementations of the p2 interfaces should be made compatible with named imports, even if unlike wasi:io they aren't a special case that should always be singular.
